summary: AFGSCI 13-5302V2 identifies a family of EWO, USSTRATCOM, safety, and technical-order publications needed to reproduce the ALCS authority/authentication procedure; those source records are not yet individually preserved in BlackIndex.
referenced_by: AFGSCI 13-5302V2, especially paragraph 4.1.2.5, paragraphs 4.4.1.2 and 5.3.3, Attachment 1, and Attachment 6
last_known_location: USAF/AFGSC e-Publishing, USSTRATCOM publication systems, and applicable technical-order repositories; some cited material may be controlled, classified, superseded, or non-public
known_creator: USAF / Air Force Global Strike Command / USSTRATCOM
stated_reason_missing: Not established as absent. The cited records have not yet been individually acquired from an authorized public or declassified first-party source.
